title: Generation Record
description: Provenance record for one generation attempt (production/generations/): provider, model, prompt package, cost, and outcome. Every generated file must have one — no orphan media.

shot.description: Shot this attempt was generated for.

provider.description: Provider ID that handled the request.

prompt_package.description: Prompt package this attempt was generated from.

request.description: What was sent, summarized. Never store API keys here.

payload_hash.description: Hash of the full request payload for exact reproduction.

provider_job_id.description: Provider-side job/task ID for async polling.

error.description: Provider error message when status is failed; null otherwise.

media_files.description: Paths to produced media, relative to the record's directory. Empty until the attempt succeeds.

cost.description: What the attempt cost (or is expected to cost). Cost control depends on this being filled honestly.

estimated.description: True for pre-flight estimates and dry runs; false once the provider bills.

seed.description: Seed actually used, when the provider reports one.

status.description: Lifecycle: dry_run writes the spec without network; rejected/approved are human review verdicts on succeeded output.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was created.
